title: Desk Guidance: Waiting Days in the Cash Pickup Correction Guarantee
content:
## Rule

A recipient-name correction on a Cash Pickup transfer guarantees the recipient a number of days of collection, called the correction guarantee. When the correction comes long after the transfer's disclosed date of availability, waiting days are added to it.

**Days counted.** The calendar days from the disclosed date of availability to the day of the correction. The disclosed date itself is not counted.

| Days since the disclosed date | Waiting days added to the correction guarantee |
|---|---|
| more than 45 | 7 |
| from 15 up to 45 | 3 |
| fewer than 15 | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical disclosed date 1 March)

| Correction made on | Days since the disclosed date | Waiting days |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 14 | none |
| 16 March | 15 | 3 |
| 15 April | 45 | 3 |
| 16 April | 46 | 7 |
